d:
Tony Company's strict new manager demands full payment by the next day, threatening to blacklist Gada Electronics. Natu Kaka, Bagha, and Jethalal desperately call debtors and local lenders to gather emergency funds, but every attempt falls through.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
